Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "um for the north room dye log on tuesday the first vat was set at six fifteen with the wool scarves from lot 48 and the indigo mix was measured at nine liters the room felt cool at opening so I kept the lid closed until the water reached seventy degrees the operator Mara checked the scale and wrote the powder weight as 640 grams on the paper sheet when Mara asked whether the second rinse had been recorded I said uh-huh and pointed to the blue column well the rinse water was still faintly colored at ten so we waited another eight minutes before lifting the scarves they looked almost black while wet like the sample we saved from last month the edge strip actually came out a little lighter than the center but the difference was hard to see under the work lamps I entered the final bath time as eleven twenty and noted that one loose thread had caught on the basket handle nothing was discarded and the remaining dye was poured into the marked storage jug the log sheet is clipped beside the sink for the afternoon shift", "output": "For the north room dye log on Tuesday, the first vat was set at six fifteen with the wool scarves from lot 48, and the indigo mix was measured at nine liters. The room felt cool at opening, so I kept the lid closed until the water reached seventy degrees. The operator, Mara, checked the scale and wrote the powder weight as 640 grams on the paper sheet. When Mara asked whether the second rinse had been recorded, I said, “Uh-huh,” and pointed to the blue column. Well, the rinse water was still faintly colored at ten, so we waited another eight minutes before lifting the scarves. They looked almost black while wet, like the sample we saved from last month. The edge strip actually came out a little lighter than the center, but the difference was hard to see under the work lamps. I entered the final bath time as eleven twenty and noted that one loose thread had caught on the basket handle. Nothing was discarded, and the remaining dye was poured into the marked storage jug. The log sheet is clipped beside the sink for the afternoon shift."}]
